introduction: In Karnataka, marriage registration is mandated by the Karnataka Marriages (Registration and Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1976. The Kaveri 2.0 portal facilitates an efficient, technology-driven application process for acquiring the legal certificate.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Service: Online Hindu Marriage Certificate Registration in Karnataka.
  • Portal: Kaveri 2.0 Online Services (kaveri.karnataka.gov.in).
  • Total Cost: ₹25 (Official Government Fee, payable after SRO approval).
  • Processing Time: A few days for the Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) to verify and approve the application.
  • Physical Visits: Completely zero/contactless if applying online with Aadhaar e-Sign.
  • Key Requirement: Aadhaar cards must be linked to active mobile numbers for the Bride, Groom, and all 3 Witnesses to complete the mandatory OTP-based e-Sign.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Marriage Registration

Note: Ensure you have clear scanned PDF copies of all proofs. The joint photo must be in JPG format.
Photo Guidelines
  • Joint Photo: A joint photo of the Bride and Groom (Must be strictly resized to exactly 2673 pixels in width and 1890 pixels in height, and be less than 2MB).
Identity & Address Proof (Bride & Groom)
  • Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card (Mandatory for e-Sign), PAN Card, Passport, or Driving License.
  • Address Proof: Voter ID, Ration Card, Bank Passbook, or Driving License.
Age & Marriage Proof
  • Age Proof: SSLC Marks Card, Birth Certificate, or Doctor's Certificate (verifying Bride is 18+ and Groom is 21+).
  • Marriage Proof: Wedding Invitation Card, Temple Receipt, Kalyana Mantapa Receipt, or a Marriage Bond.
Witnesses
  • Aadhaar details of 3 Witnesses (Typically 2 from the bride's side and 1 from the groom's side, such as parents or siblings).
  • Aadhaar-linked mobile numbers are mandatory for OTP verification in the online route.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via Kaveri 2.0 (Contactless via Aadhaar e-Sign)

If all parties (Bride, Groom, and 3 Witnesses) have an Aadhaar-linked mobile number, no SRO physical visit is required.

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Register/Login: Go to the Kaveri 2.0 portal and create a new account using your name, mobile, and email. Once registered, log in.
  2. Start Application: Click on Start a New Application > Marriage Registration > Hindu Marriage > Select Online.
  3. Upload Photo: Upload the properly resized joint photo of the bride and groom (exactly 2673x1890 PX).
  4. Fill Marriage Details: Enter the date of marriage, location, and the complete address of the wedding venue.
  5. Enter Personal Details: Fill in the Bride and Groom details respectively (Name exactly as per Aadhaar, Age, DOB, Mobile Number, Address, and Parents' details).
  6. Witness Details & e-Sign: Enter the details for all 3 witnesses and specify their relationship to the couple. Crucial Step: You must perform an "e-Sign" for all 5 people (Bride, Groom, and 3 Witnesses). Click on e-Sign, enter their Aadhaar numbers, and verify using the OTP sent to their linked mobile numbers.
  7. Select SRO: Choose the appropriate Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) from the dropdown list (usually the jurisdiction where the marriage took place or where the bride/groom resides).
  8. Upload Documents: Upload the PDF copies of Identity Proof, Age Proof, Address Proof, and Marriage Proof for the respective parties.
  9. Submit: Review the summary and submit the application. It will instantly be forwarded to the selected SRO for verification.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline/In-Person via SRO (Aadhaar Not Linked Option)

If the bride, groom, or any of the witnesses do not have an Aadhaar card linked to a mobile number for the OTP e-Sign, you must opt for the offline route.

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Initiate Online: Log into Kaveri 2.0, go to Hindu Marriage, and select the Offline mode instead of Online.
  2. Fill the Form: Fill in all the details for the bride, groom, and witnesses, and upload the supporting documents on the portal just like the online process.
  3. Generate Acknowledgment: Submit the form online to generate an application reference number/acknowledgment without doing the e-Sign step.
  4. Physical Visit: Book an appointment and visit the selected Sub-Registrar Office on the designated day.
  5. In-Person Verification: The Bride, Groom, and all three witnesses must be physically present at the SRO along with their original identity and address proof documents for physical signature and verification.
  6. Payment: Pay the nominal registration fee at the SRO directly.
afterApplying:
After Applying & Verification

  • Track Status: Log in to Kaveri 2.0 and check the "Marriage Registration" tab. Your status will initially show as Submitted for Approval.
  • SRO Verification: The Sub-Registrar will verify your uploaded documents. If correct, the application gets approved (takes 1 to 3 days). If there is a mismatch, they will add a remark and send it back for corrections.
  • Make Payment: Once approved by the SRO, the status changes to Pending for Payment. Click on Make Payment and pay the ₹25 fee via SBI ePay (UPI, Netbanking, or Debit/Credit Card).
  • Download Certificate: After the payment is successful, return to your dashboard. The status will update to Registration Completed. Click on Download Signed Copy to download your legally valid, digitally signed Marriage Certificate.
